purpose: Independent CPU reproduction of OBrush 0.1.1 Crease instability and same-input comparison with final 0.1.2 core. This does not reconstruct the reported screenshot stroke history.
fixture_origin: Independently generated Rust Mesh::sphere(level); no proprietary assets or reference application output

metrics.per_dab_flip_events: Number of triangle updates with new cross product dot immediately previous cross product <=0; accumulates events, not unique final faces
metrics.reference_normal_reversed_faces: Final face cross product dot initial sphere cross product <=0; diagnostic only, since legitimate large gradual rotations can reverse this reference
metrics.adjacent_normal_angle_over_160_edges: Unique shared edges whose final incident unit face-normal dot product < cos(160 degrees)=-0.9396926207859084; the engine prevents new folds beyond150 degrees, while preserving stricter pre-existing angle bounds
metrics.min_edge_ratio: Minimum final/initial edge length on corresponding edges
metrics.maximum_inward_displacement: Maximum -(final position-initial position) dot normalized initial sphere position; world-space geometric effect, not ZBrush response matching
metrics.timing_scope: Single native CPU measured pass, includes each dab and full-mesh f64 diagnostic scans plus snapshots; excludes final metric scan, renderer and UI. Not application FPS or pen latency.

limitations: No automatic repair of pre-damaged or nonmanifold imported meshes
No ZBrush stroke, appearance or performance comparison
No native/browser visual proof for final0.1.2 runtime
These14 fixtures do not prove safety for every topology, brush, input path or mesh size
The strength1.0 sixteen-pass fixture remains a deep deformation; local guards do not establish volume/thickness preservation
